preconditions.description: The number of mountain positions n is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(h) == n and all(0 <= h_j <= 10**12 for h_j in h)
preconditions.description: The input list h has exactly n elements, each between 0 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(h[j] < h[j + 1] for j in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The initial heights are strictly increasing: h[1] < h[2] < ... < h[n].

postconditions.expression: all(h_out[j] >= h_in[j] for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output height h_out[j] is at least the initial height h_in[j].

postconditions.expression: all(h_out[j] <= h_in[j] + sum(1 for k in range(j) if h_in[k] + 2 <= h_in[k + 1]) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output height h_out[j] is at most the initial height h_in[j] plus the total number of slides that could have affected it.

postconditions.expression: all(h_out[j] + 2 > h_out[j + 1] for j in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The landslide stops when no position j satisfies h_out[j] + 2 <= h_out[j + 1].
The total sum of heights remains unchanged after the landslide.
